caption:
Swipe to see Instagram's AI recommend Queen Elizabeth and Sonic the Hedgehog as calming artists 🤖

Instagram's AI feature generates a personalized list of artists to calm you down. One person's list included Queen Elizabeth. Another person got 2slimey, KSI, Tom Macdonald, Sonic the Hedgehog, Toby Fox, and Hatsune Miku. The post calling to take AI away from Instagram users hit 40K likes and nearly 400K views in a single day.

This is what happens when AI ships without anyone checking the output. A wellness tool became a party game and the screenshots are everywhere.
